tools.name: make_invoice
tools.description: Lay out a PDF invoice from the details the user gives: who sends it, who pays, and the lines (description, quantity, unit price, VAT %). findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pdf_tool" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
